description: This PHP source file defines the JobSpecificationModel class within the OrangeHRM system. The class implements a model for representing job specifications, including metadata such as id, filename, file type, and file size. It uses traits and annotations for API serialization and is constructed with a PartialJobSpecificationAttachment object.
